|text      = Lately, I've been visiting the [[Aisa Bathhouse]] on my own. Sitting in the water and closing my eyes to meditate made me reminisce about the past. Many of the scenes that came to mind were related to you. At first, I saw your involvement as a disturbance. After that, there were unexpected ripples along the way, ones that pushed [[Inazuma]], and even me, to move forward to this day. After the [[Mikawa Flower Festival]], perhaps you've sensed this change in my heart. Now, when I think of my old friends, I feel less sorrow — but I miss their never-fading smiles even more.

Perhaps it was because of this ever-continuing process of "transformation" that the beauty of "eternity" was gradually revealed to me. Heh... Now that I mention it, perhaps I should "transform" my tastes for once and try some new snacks.

I've prepared some, and would like for you to comment on my selection.

Oh, yes. It should be clear by now, but by "other snacks," I mean "other sweets." Only sweet foods can uphold the foundations of eternity.
